mechanism: Both drugs can cause hemolytic anemia, particularly in G6PD-deficient patients, and additive CNS depression may occur; promethazine may also inhibit metabolism of primaquine via CYP450 enzymes.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue), assess G6PD status before primaquine use, use promethazine cautiously, and counsel patients to avoid additional CNS depressants.
